data.title: Bulletproof Hosting ASN Connection Correlation — Traffic to Known BPH Networks
data.description: Detects DNS resolution or network connections to IP addresses within known bulletproof hosting (BPH) Autonomous System Number (ASN) ranges, domains registered via the NiceNIC registrar, or domains using Dynamic DNS providers such as afraid.org. Silent Push (2025) documented 200+ BPH providers controlling approximately 1 million IP addresses globally. This rule correlates network traffic against a curated list of BPH ASNs identified through abuse pattern analysis, including providers with high DGA domain density, disposable abuse contact emails, shell company registrations in permissive jurisdictions, and self-declared bulletproof hosting marketing. Additionally, the rule flags domains registered through NiceNIC — a registrar favored by threat actors (including Scattered Spider and The Com) due to its requirement for a Power of Attorney to process takedown requests — and domains leveraging Dynamic DNS services that create BPH-like abuse-resistant infrastructure. Any match warrants investigation for potential fraud-enabling infrastructure, C2 communication, or criminal hosting activity.

enrichment_required.source: MaxMind GeoIP or IP-to-ASN mapping database for resolved IP addresses
Curated BPH ASN watchlist maintained from Silent Push, Spamhaus, and threat intelligence feeds

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for BPH ASN Connection Correlation")`
`comment("Detects traffic to known BPH ASNs, NiceNIC domains, or Dynamic DNS abuse")`
index=flame_network sourcetype=flame:dns_monitoring
| lookup bph_asn_watchlist destination_asn OUTPUT bph_provider_name, bph_risk_level
| eval bph_asn_match = if(isnotnull(bph_provider_name), 1, 0)
| eval nicenic_match = if(like(domain_registrar, "%nicenic%"), 1, 0)
| eval dyndns_match = if(
    match(query, "\.(afraid\.org|mooo\.com|hopto\.org|zapto\.org|sytes\.net)$"), 1, 0)
| where bph_asn_match=1 OR nicenic_match=1 OR dyndns_match=1
| eval match_type = case(
    bph_asn_match=1, "bph_asn",
    nicenic_match=1, "nicenic_registrar",
    dyndns_match=1, "dynamic_dns")
| eval risk_category = case(
    bph_asn_match=1 AND nicenic_match=1, "high",
    bph_asn_match=1, "medium",
    nicenic_match=1, "medium",
    dyndns_match=1, "low")
| stats count AS connection_count dc(src_ip) AS unique_sources
        values(query) AS domains values(destination_asn) AS asns
        values(bph_provider_name) AS bph_providers
        values(match_type) AS match_types
  by src_ip
| sort - connection_count

references: Silent Push, Shining a Light on the Global Bulletproof Hosting Ecosystem (2025) — 200+ BPH providers, infrastructure laundering, sanctions timeline
CISA Advisory — Increased Use of Bulletproof Hosting Against Critical Infrastructure (2025)
Recorded Future, CTA-2026-0319: Criminal Exploitation of Fraud-Enabling Infrastructure, March 2026
falsepositives: Legitimate websites incidentally hosted on BPH ASNs
